description: This is a Java service class named TransactionService that handles financial transactions such as fund transfers and utility payments within a banking application. It interacts with account repositories, performs balance validation, creates transaction records, and manages the transfer logic.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing bank transactions such as fund transfers and utility payments, including validation, persistence, and transaction logic.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Performs a transfer of funds between two bank accounts, validating balances and recording transactions.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Processes a utility payment from a bank account, including balance validation and transaction recording.

methods.name: validateBalance
methods.description: Checks if the bank account has sufficient funds for a transaction; throws exception if not.

methods.name: internalFundTransfer
methods.description: Handles the core logic of transferring funds internally between two accounts, updating balances, and recording transaction entries.
